description: Infrastructures agricoles_Drainage is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Jura. Cette donnée ressence les infrastructures de drainage agricole dans le Canton. Elle comprend les chambres/puits d'accès, le reseau de drains et de canalsiation, ainsi que les polygones des périmètres drainés. Cette donnée fait partie d'un jeu de données plus large que sont les infrastructures agricoles permettant l'irrigation, l'amenée d'eau potable et d'électricité, etc. Coverage: Kanton Jura. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Jura. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
